data.name: Chaim
data.gender_notes: Chaim is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Chaim means 'life'. This name is derived from the Hebrew word 'chayim' which means 'living' or 'alive'. Chaim is a popular name in Jewish communities and has historical significance in the Bible. The name Chaim carries the meaning “Life” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Chaim usually hope their child will grow to embody life and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of life, vitality, and the continuation of the spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Chaim belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Life.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chaim total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_greek.name: Χαίμ
in_greek.long_meaning: Χαίμ είναι ονομασία που προέρχεται από την Εβραϊκή λέξη חַיִם, που σημαίνει ζωή. Ο Χριστιανισμός χρησιμοποιεί αυτό το όνομα για να περιγράψει την αιώνια ζωή της ψυχής. Η χρήση του ονόματος Χαιμ σε νεοελληνικά περιβάλλοντα γίνεται με τη μορφή Χάημος, που είναι μια πιο ελληνική μορφή του ονόματος.

in_latin.name: Chaim

Chaim is associated with positive personality traits such as kindness, compassion, and a strong sense of purpose. It is a popular name in Jewish and Christian communities, symbolizing the importance of living a virtuous life.
